articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Investors May Respond To Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Surging da Vinci Usage and New FDA Approvals. In recent days, Intuitive Surgical reported strong demand for its da Vinci robotic systems, with procedure volumes rising faster than system installations and new FDA approvals expanding the range of eligible surgical procedures. This combination of high utilization and added clinical indications reinforces the company’s platform-based model, where each installed robot can generate increasing recurring revenue from instruments and services over time.
